The final output is a native, fully editable PowerPoint (PPTX) — not a collection of images.

Key features:

- Content-driven presentation design

- Structure and storyboard before production
- Visual preview before final generation
- Native editable PowerPoint output
- Support for text, documents, images, emails, spreadsheets, and other source materials
- Human approval at key design stages

«Content determines Design.Every topic can have a different visual expression.»
